subject: Re: Isolated GPU pool pricing and compliance add-ons
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmecloud.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing request: isolated GPU pool + compliance

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this. We're evaluating a single-tenant Dedicated deployment for a latency-sensitive feature set across our platform. High-level requirements:
- Isolated GPU pool (single-tenant) — target: 8x A100 (or equivalent) with the ability to burst to 12x for short periods
- Throughput requirement: sustain ~250 tokens/sec aggregated, 200 concurrent sessions (95th percentile)
- Reserved commits: interested in 12- and 24-month committed pricing
- Compliance/privacy: private control plane, KMS/HSM integration (customer-managed keys), audit logging with 7-year retention, SOC 2 evidence and redacted pen-test summary

Questions for your pricing team:
1) How do you price the single-tenant isolation premium vs. multi-tenant Dedicated? Is it a % uplift or a fixed add-on?
2) Can you provide a pricing matrix for 4/8/16 GPU pools with throughput guarantees and the committed discounts for 12/24 month terms?
3) Are audit logging, KMS, and longer retention charged as separate line items? Any minimums?
4) How do burst capacity and SLA-backed throughput guarantees work operationally?

We need a written proposal by EOD next week (May 11) to feed into procurement. I can share an Acme procurement template if helpful.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Cloud Platform — Acme Cloud
sofia.ramos@acmecloud.com

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing request: isolated GPU pool + compliance

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear requirements, appreciated. High-level proposal below; attaching a pricing sheet (redwood_dedicated_pricing_v1.pdf) with line-item breakouts.

Summary (8x A100 baseline):
- Base reserved (Dedicated) price, 8x A100 pool: $135,000 / month (includes runtime, orchestration, autoscaling controls)
- Single-tenant isolation premium: +30% on reserved base (or optional flat isolation surcharge of $35,000/mo if you prefer fixed line item)
- Burst capacity: up to 12x for short durations allowed; burst is billed on consumed GPU-hours beyond committed capacity at 1.6x base hourly rate. Burst is limited per agreement to prevent noisy neighbor risk.
- Throughput SLO: 95th percentile response latency and throughput target will be contractually specified; we guarantee aggregated throughput for reserved pool. Operationally we reserve capacity and pre-allocate KV cache warming windows for canary windows.
- Compliance add-ons: KMS/HSM integration: $7,500 / month; Audit logging (7-year retention): $4,200 / month; SOC 2 evidence + redacted pen-test delivery: one-time $3,500 (prep/packaging)

Committed discount schedule (applies to base reserved price only):
- 12 months: 15%
- 24 months: 25%
We can roll the single-tenant premium into the committed price calculation or keep it as an add-on; contractual preference noted in the pricing sheet.

Flex options:
- If you take a 12-month commit and sign within two weeks, we can offer an onboarding credit of $10k and waive the setup fee.
- If you require customer-managed HSM and can handle the KMS connector on your side, we can reduce the KMS add-on to $2,000/mo (engineering review required).

Next steps: review attached sheet and let us know which commit term you prefer. Happy to set up a 30-min extension call with engineering to walk through the HSM/KMS integration details.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_dedicated_pricing_v1.pdf

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmecloud.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Cloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-05-05T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing request: isolated GPU pool + compliance

Jonas,

Thanks — quick clarifications before we escalate to procurement:
- The +30% isolation premium seems high relative to market benchmarks. Can you provide a short rationale or cost breakdown (networking, dedicated control plane, isolation testing) for that uplift?
- We need to see SOC 2 Type II report extract and any redacted pen-test summary before committing.
- If we bring our own HSM and handle the connector, will Redwood remove the KMS charge entirely? You mentioned an engineering review — can that be scoped and timeboxed?
- Our procurement target for 12-month committed pricing is $1.35M total ARR minimum (equivalent to $112,500/mo committed spend). Can you meet that threshold and still honor the 12%+ discount you referenced?

I'll share our procurement template (acme_purchase_terms.pdf) in a separate email.

– Sofia

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-06T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Acme pricing posture and recommended concessions (ACME-2026-D1003)

Team — quick internal note on strategy:

Context: Acme is a strategic cloud partner with a high probability of expanding to multiple accounts if onboarding goes well. They asked for a 12-month commit floor of $112,500/mo. Our starting base (8x A100 @ $135k/mo) exceeds that; if we structure with the single-tenant premium as an add-on, we can flex.

Recommended concessions for a quick close:
- Offer: 12-month commit at $120,000 / month (net after 12% upfront committed discount applied to base reserved price)
- Single-tenant premium: fixed $30,000 / month add-on (instead of 30%), subject to technical validation — reduces their sticker and keeps margin predictable for us
- KMS: if customer supplies HSM and performs connector work, waive recurring KMS charge; we will provide integration guidance and 8 engineering hours for validation (one-time).
- Onboarding: $10k credit + waive setup fee
- Approval ask: finance (Markus) to green-light up to 12% net discount on base reserved rate and one-time $10k credit; legal (Lauren) to accept standard SOC2 redaction language and include an audit-logs access clause.

If approved, Jonas can send a formal counter with these numbers.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-07T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing request: isolated GPU pool + compliance — formal counteroffer

Sofia — appreciate the quick follow-up. Per internal alignment, here is a formal counteroffer that should map cleanly into procurement:

Offer (8x A100 reserved pool):
- Committed term: 12 months
- Net committed spend: $120,000 / month (annualized $1.44M) — this reflects a 11% effective discount off our 8x base list pricing when you choose the 12-month commit and accept add-ons as structured
- Single-tenant isolation: fixed add-on $30,000 / month (technical validation required, included in scope)
- Burst: allowed up to 12x; burst billed at 1.6x hourly rate beyond committed capacity
- KMS/HSM: waived recurring KMS charge IF Acme provides HSM and handles connector work; Redwood will provide an 8-hour engineering validation window and integration docs (no charge)
- Audit logging: $4,200 / month for 7-year retention (we can discuss retention tiering to reduce cost)
- SOC2 + redacted pen-test: we will provide a SOC 2 summary and a redacted pen-test artifact under NDA; delivery ETA 3 business days after NDA execution
- Onboarding credit: $10,000 credit and setup fee waived if contract is signed within 14 days of this email

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf (line-item pricing), SOC2-summary.pdf (summary artifact).

We can also convert the single-tenant premium into the committed calculation if you prefer an all-in committed line item; let me know. I can push a DocuSign envelope with the term sheet if this matches your procurement template.

Next step: I can schedule a 30-minute technical workshop (engineer + solution architect) to confirm HSM integration and throughput SLO measurement.

Cheers,
Jonas

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acmecloud.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: 2026-05-10T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing request: isolated GPU pool + compliance — formal counteroffer

Jonas / Marissa — appreciate the quick pivot and the clarity. A few final asks before we route to legal and procurement:
1) We need a written throughput SLA tied to the committed 8x pool (95th pct aggregated throughput). Please include remediation credits and measurement windows.
2) Audit logs: Acme requires the ability to run periodic audit exports and to have read access to audit logs for compliance teams. Please confirm support and whether that is included in the $4,200/mo line item or a separate professional-services task.
3) DocuSign: please send the term sheet and lock pricing through May 17 so we can complete internal approvals.

If the above are in writing, procurement is likely to accept the financial terms and move to signatures. Also request a technical workshop next week for HSM validation.

Thanks — will confirm final sign-off after SLA + audit access language is received.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Cloud Platform — Acme Cloud

Attachment: acme_purchase_terms.pdf (procurement template)
